headline: KMD Brands Shares Plunge After Acquisition Discussions with Bluestar Alliance End
summary: Shares in Kathmandu owner KMD Brands dropped over 15% after takeover discussions with US firm Bluestar Alliance collapsed following the end of an exclusivity period.
why: KMD Brands is a New Zealand-listed outdoor apparel retailer that owns brands including Kathmandu, Rip Curl, and Oboz.

impacts.name: KMD Brands Ltd
impacts.why: Share price dropped steeply after buy-out negotiations with Bluestar Alliance were terminated.
impacts.baseline_rule: first recorded price at or after created_at (15-minute price recorder); end = first price at least 24 h later, within 48 h

why_moved: Termination of buyout talks eliminated the acquisition premium built into stock valuations.
